dog.description_text:
This pet is available only through ACC New Hope partners. To adopt or foster, please complete the pre-screener form below. Inquiries sent directly to ACC will not receive a response.

Pre-Screener Form

Modela was surrendered by her previous owner due to ongoing personal concerns in the home. During her stay in care, she has shown highly fearful behavior, including hard barking, growling, avoiding handlers, and reluctance to leave her kennel, resulting in snapping at and thrashing on leash. She also shows high levels of stress in novel environments such as the play yard, pacing, panting, and consistently seeking exit. Her previous owners report that she is undersocialized, and may bark and growl at unfamiliar people and dogs; they also report that she is anxious when left alone. They otherwise describe her as a playful, active, independent dog who enjoys going on runs, loves water, and has done well with handling such as bathing and brushing. Due to her reported behavior in the home, and the highly fearful and defensive behavior observed in the care center, we recommend she be placed in an adult-only home with a New Hope partner who can provide any necessary behavior modification (force-free, positive reinforcement-based) and re-evaluate behavior in a stable home environment before placement into a permanent home.
dog.name: Modela
